economy.title: Keep the same logistics vehicle for pallet runs
steps: Deliver a pallet into a control zone or hot zone.
Keep the same occupied vehicle between counted deliveries.
Build the crate streak through 11 counted deliveries to reach the formula cap.
conditions: Target is in control zone or hot zone.
Driver role context selects GroundPalletReward for the 500 XP base.
formulaNotes: Pallet XP bypasses the SupplyCrateValue curve using DefaultFactor=1.
Cash zone multiplier is 2; XP zone multiplier is 1.
Crate streak uses clamp(CrateStreak-1,0,10).

economy.title: Ground passenger deliveries build cash and XP streaks
steps: Carry passengers until the game marks their drop-off eligible.
Drop them in a hot zone for the 2x cash zone branch.
Continue counted deliveries in the same vehicle.
conditions: Driver context chooses GroundVehicleReward unless a spawn-vehicle selector matches.
Cash multiplies by the PlayerCount curve; XP formula has no PlayerCount multiplier.
formulaNotes: Player streak uses clamp(PlayerStreak-1,0,25).
Ground cash base is 350; each clamped streak step adds 25.
Driver XP base is 250; each clamped streak step adds 5.

economy.title: Revive teammates inside objective zones
steps: Revive a teammate whose position is inside the objective.
Spread revives across teammates to avoid the repeat-target reduction.
conditions: Cash weights target position by 1 and reviver position by 0.
Full revive uses AssistScalar=1; contributor rewards are scaled.
XP LastKiller selector can reduce base reward to zero.
formulaNotes: Target zone cash factor: normal 1, control 2, hot zone 4.
Repeat factor is 1-clamp(LastVictimCount,0,4)*0.24; floor is 0.04.

economy.title: Fight inside the objective and retain kill streak
steps: Fight while both shooter and target are in the hot zone.
Build the qualifying kill streak through kill 6.
Use headshots for the matching base-reward branch.
conditions: Normal cash zone weights are 0.5 shooter and 0.5 target.
Explosive/sniper/artillery cases change weights and streak handling.
Repeated victims and crew-assist contexts reduce payouts.
formulaNotes: Cash streak adds 50*clamp(KillStreak-1,0,5) before zone factors.
Hot zone factor is 10; control-zone factor is 5.
Headshot base 350, ordinary base 300; AssaultKill branches are 400/450.
Revenge factor 2 and stopped-streak factor 1.5 have their own selectors.
Crew penalty is 0.8^clamp(CrewCount-1,0,5).

economy.title: Transport, revives and supply crates create later assist payouts
steps: Transport, revive or supply teammates before their later eligible kill.
Let the matching assist tracker event grant its share.
conditions: Logistic cash default is 0.5 of passed-in BaseReward; spawn-vehicle and not-in-vehicle branches use 0.25.
Revive and supply-crate cash use 0.25 of passed-in BaseReward.
Friendly contexts have zero-reward selectors where present.
formulaNotes: Default logistic/revive/supply-crate kill-assist XP is 50.
Spawn-vehicle or not-in-vehicle logistics XP branches use 25.
Duration and eligibility are tracker/state-tree dependent; BaseReward is event input.

economy.title: Supply-crate purchases can reward the owner
steps: Place a supply crate teammates can use.
Receive the matching purchase event rewards when they buy from it.
conditions: PurchaseValue and MarkupMultiplier are event inputs.
formulaNotes: Cash: PurchaseValue*(MarkupMultiplier-(MarkupMultiplier-1)*clamp(LastVictimCount,0,10)/10).
XP uses the PurchaseValue XP curve times (1-clamp(LastVictimCount,0,10)*0.1).
At repeat count 10, markup bonus falls to PurchaseValue and the XP factor reaches zero.
